scope: Standalone S31 USB EP1 packet peer/IRQ, fixed ELF ROM payload reconstruction and LP scratch. Product INK4 Plus remains unavailable.
sources: sources.json: fixed ESP-IDF v6.1 fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643 USB Serial/JTAG reg/LL, lp_system_reg/rtc.h, bus_monitor_reg (next boundary), fixed 20260528 public S31 ROM

usb.supported: Guest byte FIFO, full/WR_DONE packet commit, explicit host consumption, RX packet/empty/IN token raw/ena/clear, clock gating, CLIC delivery
usb.host: Explicit attach_host/host_send/host_receive; no peer is attached by default. Example --usb-host drains after each1000-instruction batch; functional boundary only.

romLoader.method: Place explicit matching ELF RAM-section bytes into their ROM-side source holes. Reject missing/misaligned/out-of-window/conflicting data. Guest _init executes every copy/clear operation.
romLoader.observedRam: 0x2f07fff4 is zero immediately after load; after6303 guest instructions at PC0x2f801852 it equals exact ELF payload0x2f84882c.

lpScratch.effect: Full32-bit software storage; STORE4 bit0 is ROM log control per rtc.h.
lpScratch.limitation: Only current bus lifetime; reset/sleep-domain retention not implemented.
